description: List Formgong's free, MIT-licensed website templates (complete sites with a contact or quote form already wired to Formgong): name, niche, live demo, source, HTML download and a command to start from it. Starting from a template is much faster than generating a site from scratch. After choosing one, put the form's public access key (fk_…) where the template has fk_your_access_key.

topic.description: Only templates for this niche: trades (Trades and home services), consulting (Consulting and B2B services), portfolio (Portfolios and studios), construction (Construction and real estate), health (Clinics and health), food (Restaurants and cafes), shops (Shops and makers).
